name: Control Policy Conflict
description: Windows MDM settings in the Control Policy Conflict category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: MDM Wins Over GP
properties.description: If set to 1 then any MDM policy that is set that has an equivalent GP policy will result in GP service blocking the setting of the policy by GP MMC. Setting the value to 0 (zero) or deleting the policy will remove the GP policy blocks restore the saved GP policies.

enum.description: The MDM policy is used and the GP policy is blocked.
